import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[] nxt = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            nxt[i] = (int)(((long)i * k) % n);
        }

        boolean[] seen = new boolean[n + 1];
        int components = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            if (!seen[i]) {
                explore(i, nxt, seen);
                components++;
            }
        }

        long result;
        if (k == 1) {
            result = modPow(n, n, MOD);
        } else {
            result = modPow(n, components, MOD);
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }

    static void explore(int start, int[] nxt, boolean[] seen) {
        int cur = start;
        while (true) {
            seen[cur] = true;
            int v = nxt[cur];
            if (seen[v]) {
                break;
            }
            cur = v;
        }
    }

    static long modPow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
